Subject: RoundTable POC outcomes & quick micro-testimony request

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for running the POC with us - the results look great. High level recap attached (redwood-poc-summary.pdf). Key outcomes from the 3-week POC vs. your baseline:
- Median token latency down from ~520ms to ~130ms (approx 75% reduction)
- Sustained throughput improved 2.8x on the same hardware profile
- Estimated inference spend down ~35% at production throughput
- Peak 95th percentile latency spikes reduced by ~60%

We'd love to share a short customer micro-testimony (one to two sentences) + permission to display RoundTable AI's logo on the case study/website. If possible a 5-10 minute call to capture a 10-15 second audio clip would be wonderful, but a written 1-2 sentence quote is also great.

Would you be open to either option? If yes, Marissa (cc'd) will coordinate a quick slot. Attached: redwood-poc-summary.pdf (metrics + sample queries).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
